lines.text: Many learners say: I am looking my keys.
Better: I am looking for my keys.
Looking for! I am looking for my keys.

data.right: I am looking for my keys.

native.tip: En español “busco mis llaves”, pero en inglés “look” solo es mirar; para buscar: “look for.”
native.caption: 🙈 Error común: “I am looking my keys.” “Look” es mirar; “look for” es buscar: “I am looking for my keys.” ¡Escucha a Ama y repite! Practica más en la app Lexkite.
native.comment: Respuesta: “look for”. “Look” sola es mirar. Para buscar algo di “look for”. Escribe una frase tuya con “look for” o dila en voz alta: {link}

en.tip: In English “look” alone means “mirar”; to search, say “look for.”
en.caption: Common mistake: “I am looking my keys.” “Look” is “mirar”; “look for” is “buscar”: “I am looking for my keys.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
